scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of the default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false), not the author's working copy. Go project: full interface/data-access detection for Go is out of scope for skill version 1.0; dependency manifests, secrets patterns, HTTP client usage, CLI flags and file writes were reviewed by reading the source. Go dependencies are listed under an extra key dependencies.go. Extra key secrets_and_credentials.cli_credential_exposure was added for the --pass flag. The project is a CLI client, not a server, so there are no routes.

gitignore_gaps: .env, .env.*, *.pem, *.key, credentials.json are not excluded; .gitignore excludes *.json (benchmark result files) and bin/

findings: go 1.23; direct: fatih/color v1.15.0, urfave/cli/v2 v2.27.7; 6 indirect; all pinned by go.sum
golang.org/x/sys v0.6.0 is an old indirect version (no CVE claim made)

proper_secret_handling_found.mechanism: buildCommandLine masks the password when echoing the command line into reports
CODECOV_TOKEN read from GitHub Actions secrets

cli_credential_exposure.detail: login password is accepted via the --pass command-line flag (no env var or prompt alternative seen), so it can appear in shell history and process lists

interfaces.network_binding: none (client only; makes outbound HTTP(S) requests to the user-supplied --url)

external_apis.host: user-supplied ActaLog instance (--url); committed report shows https://al.fluidgrid.site

same target: POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/version, /api/workouts, /api/movements, /api/wods, /api/pr-movements, /api/notifications/count; POST /api/benchmark (server-side benchmark, up to 500000 records)

file_system_access.detail: writes JSON benchmark results to a user-specified path (0644)
writes Markdown report (0644); creates output directories
reads prior benchmark JSON files from a directory and writes a comparison report

sensitive_data_indicators.field_or_variable: personal email address and production URL recorded in committed report (reports/benchmark_2026-01-03_202645.md, 'User' row)

what_this_app_can_do: Measures connectivity (DNS, TCP, TLS), health, API endpoint latency, frontend assets and concurrent load against a user-specified ActaLog server.
Logs in to the target with a supplied email and password and calls authenticated API endpoints with the returned JWT.
Can trigger the server's /api/benchmark endpoint, which generates up to 500000 records server-side.
Writes JSON and Markdown reports and compares earlier result files.

data_sources_touched.access: read_write (login POST, GETs, server-side benchmark POST)

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Local command-line tool run by the user; no listener. It reaches whatever host the user points it at, including production instances.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: Password accepted as a --pass command-line argument
A committed report contains a personal email address and the production URL of the tested instance
Load testing and the server-side benchmark can create heavy load or records on the target

top_findings: Committed report discloses a personal email address and production URL
No hardcoded secrets or secret files found
